stations.title: Wilma
stations.say: Why does git status list all this?

stations.title: git status
stations.text: Three kinds of files that are not the site.
stations.note: One git add would take them in.

captions: Wilma wants git status to show only the shop's website.
The till's export, Femi's drafts and an upload log crowd every list, one of them tracked.
You write the rules Git follows and make it forget one file, in four tasks.
git status is quiet, and the upload log stays on disk where its tool needs it.
The rules are in the history, so they travel with the site.
